One app,
semua onz

Trusted by millions for everyday needs

TNG eWallet brings your payments, money management, rewards and travel together in one app.​

Whether you are paying for lunch, booking flights, sending money home, or saving for your future, everything happens in one secure place. No switching between apps. No extra steps. Just tap and go.​

Built for locals, tourists and expats in Malaysia, TNG eWallet makes everyday life simple and seamless.​

Manage and grow your money​

Take control of your finances with GOfinance. Apply for loans, build your savings and track your spending easily. ​

Everything you need to manage your money smarter, all within TNG eWallet.

Learn more

Everyday payments. Real rewards.

Pay for food, shopping, bills and more using TNG eWallet. Earn cashback, vouchers and exclusive perks through GOrewards every time you spend.

One app for daily payments and meaningful rewards.

Learn more about GOrewards

Plan and power every trip

Book flights and hotels and enjoy travel deals with GOtravel. Manage bookings, stay on budget and pay securely anywhere in the world with TNG eWallet.

Travel planning made easy from start to finish.

Learn more about GOtravel

Security you can trust

Your money matters. TNG eWallet is regulated by Bank Negara Malaysia and the Securities Commission Malaysia, with strong security measures to protect every transaction.

Learn more at our Security Centre

Your money is safe and secure with us
